notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'you may search your library and/or graveyard for A Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield.' At turn 3's upkeep seat 0 fires the may and searches its library only (option 1) with two Shrines in it: exactly one (Shrine A, its choice) is put onto the battlefield, never two. Shrine B is not put onto the battlefield: it stays in the library (the library was shuffled and the draw step took another card; the seed fixes that).
